text:
Nora H: Game night Friday? Thinking "Retro + Modern" theme: PS5 couch co-op, a Steam Deck corner for handheld matches, and an emulator station for split-screen SNES/Genesis. Bring whatever you prefer.

Ben C: Love it. I can bring my PS5 + extra DualSense and a 55" TV. I'll also grab a multi-outlet surge protector.

Izumi S: I'll bring my Steam Deck and a USB-C dock. Heads up: some Decks act weird over Wi-Fi for Remote Play; wired is best.

Marco P: I can bring my CRT and a low-latency upscaler (OSSCRT>HDMI). If anyone has SCART cables or old AV leads, bring 'em. Retro station incoming. :thumbsup:

Nora H: Amazing. We might need an HDMI switch and a small audio splitter so people can use wired headsets without unplugging speakers.

Ben C: I have a 4-in HDMI switch and an optical audio splitter. Also will bring short HDMI patch cables.

Izumi S: For folks joining remotely via Steam Remote Play / Parsec, test before Friday. Quick tip: set Steam Deck to wired mode on the host and enable low-latency streaming in Steam settings.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Start time" "6:30pm" "7:30pm" "8:30pm"

partybot: Poll created: "Start time"  6:30pm (2), 7:30pm (2), 8:30pm (0).

Nora H: Looks like 6:30 is winning. Logistics: roof access code posted in #events. Can someone also bring a small fold-up table for the emulator station?

Marco P: Table and CRT power cable covered. Also bringing a master list of retro ROMs (legal gray area  please only use owned dumps).

Ben C: I'll tape a sign with controller assignments so people don't swap mid-match. People, label your controllers!

Izumi S: Minor Deck note: if you're using a controller that vibrates a lot, disable haptics in the Steam Input profile to avoid drift.

Nora H: Can someone handle recording short highlights? A 20s clip for #random would be great.

Marco P: I'll clip a goofy 20s segment of the Mario Kart chaos.

Maya (events): Also: snacks? I'm ordering pizza and samosas. Any allergies?

Ben C: Vegan + nut-free would be great.

Izumi S: No nuts for me either.

Nora H: Networking: rooftop Wi-Fi drops sometimes. Suggest tethering one phone as fallback and bring an ethernet-to-USB-C adapter for the docked Deck if possible. If you want to pre-set a local SSID for Remote Play test, use: `SSID: redwood-games, PW: playnight2023` (temporary).

Marco P: I'll bring a little travel router and an ethernet cable. That should help for the emulator netplay.

Ben C: Also bringing an HDMI capture (USB3). If anyone wants their match recorded, shout.

Izumi S: Quick technical note for RetroArch netplay: set latency to 2 and use runahead for smoother sync. Happy to help configure on-site.

Maya (events): partybot:poll "Game picks" "Mario Kart" "Street Fighter II (versus)" "Castlevania co-op" "Steam Deck tournaments"

partybot: Poll created: "Game picks"  Mario Kart (3), Street Fighter II (1), Castlevania (0), Steam Deck (2).

Nora H: Great, looks like Mario Kart + some 1v1s. Final checklist: HDMI switch (Ben), CRT + upscaler (Marco), Deck + dock (Izumi), PS5 + TV (Ben), table (Marco), snacks (Maya). See you Friday 6:30pm. Bring jackets  rooftop breeze gets real after sunset. :evergreen_tree:

Maya (events): Event posted with door code and reminder to bring ID for roof access.

Ben C: If anyone needs a ride up with heavy gear, ping me.

Izumi S: I'll film a tiny highlight reel on my phone and drop it here after.

Marco P: Can't wait. Also, who wants to host a friendly best-of-3 for the cereal box prize?

Nora H: I'll run the bracket. Low pressure, high bragging rights. :trophy:
